The work can run during a per-link prefetch or navigation, while the fallback of the nearest [``](https://react.dev/reference/react/Suspense) boundary renders in the shell. Use `prefetch()` for content that the App Shell would otherwise render but that is expensive to generate. Static prerenders still include the content in their output. ## Usage The function requires [Cache Components](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/cacheComponents) and throws an error if not enabled. Without [Partial Prefetching](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/partialPrefetching) a route has no App Shell, so the function has no effect. Enable Partial Prefetching globally, or one route at a time, by [adopting Partial Prefetching](/docs/app/guides/adopting-partial-prefetching). ```ts filename="next.config.ts" highlight={4,5} import type { NextConfig } from 'next' const nextConfig: NextConfig = { cacheComponents: true, partialPrefetching: true, } export default nextConfig ``` With Partial Prefetching enabled, Next.js loads server-rendered output in stages, before and during a client navigation. These are the route's [navigation stages](/docs/app/glossary#navigation-stages): 1. A default `` loads the App Shell, which holds the part of the route that does not depend on the URL. 2. An optional [``](/docs/app/api-reference/components/link#prefetch), or [`router.prefetch(href, { kind: 'full' })`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/use-router), can also load content that depends on the link's URL. 3. When the user follows the link, the navigation renders the rest of the route. During runtime rendering, awaiting `prefetch()` keeps content out of the App Shell, so it renders during a per-link prefetch or navigation. Static prerenders can still include the content. Calling `router.prefetch(href)` without `kind: 'full'` requests only the App Shell under Partial Prefetching. It does not render content below `await prefetch()`. To keep content out of per-link prefetches as well, so it renders only on the navigation, use [`navigation()`](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/navigation). > **Good to know**: `prefetch()` defers one subtree. To require a static App Shell across the route, use [`ensureStatic = 'shell'`](/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/route-segment-config/ensureStatic#shell). See [Keeping pages static](/docs/app/guides/keeping-pages-static) for a worked example. Deferral is scoped to the component that awaits it and the tree below: sibling branches render in the shell as usual. It excludes the code that follows from prerendering and prefetching, making that work request-dependent. Awaiting `prefetch()` excludes the code that follows from the App Shell. Producing the App Shell does not run that code, so its upstream requests are not issued until a per-link prefetch or the navigation. Leaving content uncached also keeps it out of the shell, but gives up its cache lifetime and cannot make it available during a per-link prefetch.
